_doc: FINALS WEEK 1 — the first finals application. A FINALS WEEK IS NOT A ROUND ADVANCE: feed round 25 is a ledger key, the CALENDAR round is HELD at 24, calendar_progress stays 1.00, and every non-finalist's completed season is untouched. Because the board moves and the round does not, this act EARNS an out-of-round column and a lineage entry, exactly as a dial flip does (standing owner rule 2026-07-28).
